notes.title: Bugfix and network optimization update
notes.content:
Today's update fixes a few bugs and significantly optimizes network usage so gamers who experienced difficulty playing online games due to limited bandwidth should have greater chance to play it now. It also adds loading progress indicator as well as "darkness" setting for those playing on TV screens who might find the game too dark on their screen.

If you still experience any bugs please report them to contact[at]awesomegamesstudio[dot]com so we can fix them for you.

notes.title: Deathmatch mode, local multiplayer and visual upgrade!
notes.content:
This update adds completely new game mode: Deathmatch, where your goal is to kill other players and don't get eaten by zombies, as well as several other features such as:
- Local mulitplayer
- A new barricade type "Propane Tank Barricade"
- Reworked barricades, turrets and background visuals
- Ping indicator

Hope you're going to enjoy the update, especially the Deathmatch mode!

tags.feature: - A new barricade type "Propane Tank Barricade"
- Reworked barricades, turrets and background visuals

notes.title: Leveling up and powerups update
notes.content:
Today's update introduces character upgrades and powerups that will allow you to leave your base at later nights and survive longer than before.

Here's the list of character upgrades:
- Movement speed
- Reloading speed
- Toughness
- Health regeneration
- Pickup range

And powersups that boost your character for a short duration:
- Invulnerability
- Fast reload
- Invisibility
- Speed boost
- Magnet

Have fun!

notes.title: Content update
notes.content:
The new update adds some useful gear to help you fight the zombie horde:
- Chainsaw
- Freeze gun
- Blaster
- Grenades
- Landmines
- Electro barricades
- Upgraded turrets

It also includes a lot of rendering optimizations that allowed some balance changes:
- There can now be up to 50% more zombies on screen at the same time
- Zombies get tougher at a slower rate than before
- Basic turret's cost reduced to $6000

Apologies to everyone who waited for the update for too long and hopefully next time the wait will be much shorter!

tags.balance_change: - There can now be up to 50% more zombies on screen at the same time
- Zombies get tougher at a slower rate than before

notes.title: Endless Night mode is now available
notes.content:
Today's update adds new game mode: Endless Night. In this mode there's no base building or shopping, only brainless zombie-shooting. It's designed as a short distraction so that a single playthrough takes just a couple minutes. There are also three new achievements related to this mode.

Other features included in this update:
[list][*]More responsive user interface
[*]Keyboard controls mapping
[*]Leaderboard anti-cheat tools
[*]Better multithreading support
[*]Option to adjust amount of blood
[*]Minor bug fixes[/list]

While it took quite a long time to release this update, the behind-the-scenes work done will allow future updates to be released more frequently - the next one will be released in few weeks.

tags.feature: Today's update adds new game mode: Endless Night.
There are also three new achievements related to this mode.
Option to adjust amount of blood

notes.title: The first update to the game
notes.content:
The first update to the game is now live:
[list]
     [*]Due to large amount of reported trolling, only the host can now buy items and build base in public games 
     [*]It is now possible to ban players from the game
     [*]Added separate leaderboards for solo, duo, trio and quartet games
     [*]Added mouse sensitivity setting
     [*]The game now supports resolutions higher than 1920x1080
	 [*]Flamethrower damage increased
     [*]Multiple bug fixes
[/list]
Also there's a special thread listing features that will be added to the game in future updates:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/270550/discussions/0/540738051649788582/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/270550/discussions/0/540738051649788582/[/url]

If you have any other ideas or requests, please post them in the forums.
